sentences.zh: 美国政治中似乎在一夜之间出现了一个新的战场。

sentences.en: In Colorado, they have been getting national attention.
sentences.zh: 在科罗拉多州，他们一直备受全国关注。

sentences.en: A record amount of money has been spent on school board races this year.
sentences.zh: 今年，学校董事会选举的资金支出创下了纪录。

sentences.en: School boards.
sentences.zh: 学校董事会。

sentences.en: Police were called to a school board meeting.
sentences.zh: 警察被叫到了学校董事会会议上。

sentences.en: My master!
sentences.zh: 我的主人！

sentences.en: Over the past year, school board meetings have become the site of heated, at times, violent fights between parents.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，学校董事会会议已经成为家长之间激烈、有时甚至暴力争吵的场所。

sentences.en: Parents were caught on tape saying, quote, we know who you are.
sentences.zh: 有家长在录音中说，原话是，我们知道你是谁。

sentences.en: And others saying, quote, we will find you.
sentences.zh: 还有人说，原话是，我们会找到你。

sentences.en: We will find you and we know who you are.
sentences.zh: 我们会找到你，而且我们知道你是谁。

sentences.en: You will never be allowed in public again.
sentences.zh: 你们再也不会被允许出现在公众面前。

sentences.en: No more math.
sentences.zh: 不再有数学。

sentences.en: All over the country's most polarizing issues.
sentences.zh: 全都是围绕着这个国家最具两极分化的议题。

sentences.en: The truth is that CRT is utterly disgusting and raciSt.
sentences.zh: 事实是，批判性种族理论（CRT）极其令人作呕且充满种族歧视。

sentences.en: This isn't critical race theory.
sentences.zh: 这不是批判性种族理论。

sentences.en: This is diversity inclusion.
sentences.zh: 这是多元化和包容性。

sentences.en: As money and attention have flowed into local board races.
sentences.zh: 随着资金和关注度涌入地方董事会选举。

sentences.en: And this is something we're seeing across Northeast Ohio and across the state.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在俄亥俄州东北部和整个州都能看到的情况。

sentences.en: Central Iowa school board elections were more expensive, divisive, and controversial than ever before.
sentences.zh: 爱荷华州中部学校董事会选举比以往任何时候都更加昂贵、更具分裂性和争议性。

sentences.en: The battle has been taken up on the national stage.
sentences.zh: 这场争斗已经搬上了全国舞台。

sentences.en: In Northern Virginia, the deciding issue for a quarter of voters is education.
sentences.zh: 在弗吉尼亚州北部，四分之一选民的决定性议题是教育。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the question of who sits on a school board has become a question about which version of America will prevail today.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，谁进入学校董事会的问题，变成了一个关乎哪种版本的美国将在今天取胜的问题。

sentences.en: Ahead of this month's school board elections, my colleague Campbell Robertson traveled to one school district in Bucks County, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 在本月的学校董事会选举之前，我的同事坎贝尔·罗伯逊前往宾夕法尼亚州巴克斯县的一个学区进行了采访。

sentences.en: In part one, how did it get like this?
sentences.zh: 第一部分：局势是如何变成这样的？

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, November 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月16日，星期二。

sentences.en: Campbell, there are a lot of wild stories coming out of school board meetings all across the country right now.
sentences.zh: 坎贝尔，现在全国各地的学校董事会会议上都传出了很多离奇的故事。

sentences.en: So, why did you go to Bucks County, Pennsylvania?
sentences.zh: 那么，你为什么去了宾夕法尼亚州的巴克斯县？

sentences.en: Well, for one thing, I'd heard that the Central Bucks school board meetings were particularly wild.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一方面，我听说中央巴克斯学区的董事会会议格外离奇。

sentences.en: I mean, people shouting, people getting harassed outside of the meetings.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有人大喊大叫，有人在会场外遭到骚扰。

sentences.en: So, there was that.
sentences.zh: 所以，有这方面的原因。

sentences.en: But it's also that Bucks is a really important county in national politics.
sentences.zh: 但也是因为巴克斯县在全国政治中是一个非常重要的县。

sentences.en: You know, Pennsylvania is already a swing state.
sentences.zh: 你知道，宾夕法尼亚州本来就是一个摇摆州。

sentences.en: And in Bucks, the voters are pretty much the prize voters being fought over by both parties.
sentences.zh: 而在巴克斯县，选民基本上是两党争夺的关键选民。

sentences.en: It's a suburban county, suburbs of Philly, middle and upper middle class voters, predominantly white but diversifying, pretty well educated.
sentences.zh: 这是一个郊区县，费城郊区，中产阶级和中产阶级以上的选民，以白人为主但正在走向多元化，受教育程度相当高。

sentences.en: But they're up for grabs.
sentences.zh: 但他们的投票倾向尚未最终确定。

sentences.en: And this year, the issues that have become so politicized, curriculum, COVID policies, are school issues.
sentences.zh: 而今年，那些高度政治化的议题，比如课程设置、新冠防疫政策，都是学校的问题。

sentences.en: And these types of voters are invested in schools more than almost anything else.
sentences.zh: 这类选民对学校的投入几乎超过了其他任何事情。

sentences.en: So, any small change in Bucks with that particular demographic could have national implications.
sentences.zh: 因此，巴克斯县在这一特定人口统计群体中的任何微小变化，都可能产生全国性的影响。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Campbell, when you got to Bucks County, what's the story you found about how the situation with the school boards there got to be the way that it is?
sentences.zh: 那么，坎贝尔，当你到达巴克斯县时，你发现关于那里的学校董事会局势如何演变成今天这个样子的故事是什么？

sentences.en: Well, when I started reporting it, I didn't think that would be so hard to answer or that it would be so complicated.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我开始做报道时，我没想到这个问题会这么难回答，也没想到它会如此复杂。

sentences.en: And honestly,
sentences.zh: 老实说，

sentences.en: unless you went back and listened to every minute of every school board meeting for the last year and a half and went through every comment on all these private Facebook groups,
sentences.zh: 除非你回去听过去一年半里每一次学校董事会会议的每一分钟，并翻遍所有这些私人 Facebook 群组中的每一条评论，

sentences.en: I don't think you can totally, fully answer that question.
sentences.zh: 否则我认为你无法完全、彻底地回答这个问题。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Well, that's why we have you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是为什么我们有你。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But I've spent a lot of time talking to people in the Central Bucks School District on all sides of the story.
sentences.zh: 但我花了很多时间与中央巴克斯学区持各种立场的各方人士交谈。

sentences.en: And I think I understand enough to tell you that it's a complete mess.
sentences.zh: 我想我了解得足够多，可以告诉你这是一个彻头彻尾的烂摊子。

sentences.en: Even when I was reporting this story, you find people in the middle of this and they can't remember exactly how it started to go off the rails.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我报道这个故事时，你发现身处风暴中心的这些人也记不清事情究竟是如何开始失控的。

sentences.en: I mean, they think they know, but they think back and they're like, oh, wait a minute, it was here.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们以为自己知道，但回想起来却觉得，哦，等等，是在这里。

sentences.en: No, it was actually before that.
sentences.zh: 不，其实在那之前就开始了。

sentences.en: But, you know, whether it's the local school board meeting or the whole state of American democracy, it did evolve to this point.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，无论是地方学校董事会会议还是整个美国民主的现状，它确实演变到了这一步。

sentences.en: And it's worth figuring out how it got here.
sentences.zh: 弄清楚它是如何走到这一步是很有价值的。

sentences.en: So, where exactly should we begin in Bucks?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们究竟应该从巴克斯县的哪里开始呢？

sentences.en: If everybody's ready, we'll go ahead and get started.
sentences.zh: 如果大家都准备好了，我们就开始吧。

sentences.en: Let's start in the summer of 2020.
sentences.zh: 让我们从2020年夏天开始。

sentences.en: I'd like to call to order the Central Bucks School District School Board meeting of June 23rd, 2020.
sentences.zh: 我宣布中央巴克斯学区2020年6月23日的学校董事会会议正式开始。

sentences.en: Would everyone please rise for the Pledge of Allegiance?
sentences.zh: 请全体起立，行效忠礼。

sentences.en: I pledge allegiance to the flag.
sentences.zh: 我效忠于国旗。

sentences.en: At this point, the school board is focused, like pretty much the whole country, on figuring out how they're going to come back to school in the fall.
sentences.zh: 此时，和几乎整个国家一样，学校董事会的重点是弄清楚他们将如何在秋季返校。

sentences.en: Remember, there was pretty much universal shutdowns in those first few months leading up to that summer.
sentences.zh: 记住，在通往那个夏天的最初几个月里，几乎是全国范围内的全面封锁。

sentences.en: But now the question is, will schools reopen in the fall?
sentences.zh: 但现在的问题是，学校会在秋季重新开放吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Next, we are into public comment.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们进入公众评论环节。

sentences.en: We have quite a few.
sentences.zh: 我们有相当多的发言。

sentences.en: And this is when we start to see a lot of concerned parents showing up.
sentences.zh: 也就是在这个时候，我们开始看到大量焦虑的家长出现。

sentences.en: Our first commenter this evening is Catherine Abbott Cutler of New Britain.
sentences.zh: 今晚的第一个发言者是来自新不列颠的凯瑟琳·阿博特·卡特勒。

sentences.en: You know, school board meetings are usually kind of low turnout affairs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，学校董事会会议通常是那种投票率较低的事务。

sentences.en: Well, suddenly the board meetings in Central Bucks, which at this point are happening over Zoom, are getting like 60 or 70 comments from parents at every meeting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，突然之间，中央巴克斯的董事会会议（此时是通过 Zoom 召开的）每次会议都有来自家长的60或70条评论。

sentences.en: And almost all of them are about this looming decision about whether schools will reopen in person.
sentences.zh: 而且几乎所有这些评论都关于那个迫在眉睫的决定，即学校是否会恢复线下上课。

sentences.en: Understandably.
sentences.zh: 可以理解。

sentences.en: Totally understandably.
sentences.zh: 完全可以理解。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Sandra Hill of New Britain.
sentences.zh: 新不列颠的桑德拉·希尔。

sentences.en: I am commenting today in hopes that the board will understand that I am one of many families that wish to return to school, but with safety provisions in place.
sentences.zh: 我今天发表评论是希望董事会能够明白，我是众多希望重返校园的家庭之一，但前提是要有安全保障措施。

sentences.en: And some of the parents are urging the schools to be cautious.
sentences.zh: 一些家长敦促学校保持谨慎。

sentences.en: The current situation stinks, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当前的局势糟透了，绝对如此。

sentences.en: But this is our world right now, and it is our duty to teach children that we have to adapt to changing environments.
sentences.zh: 但这就是我们眼前的世界，我们的责任是教导孩子们，我们必须适应不断变化的环境。

sentences.en: But that's not the majority of parents.
sentences.zh: 但那并不是大多数家长。

sentences.en: Pam and Frank Maciocho of Warrington.
sentences.zh: 沃灵顿的帕姆和弗兰克·马西奥科。

sentences.en: The majority of parents are saying, we want you to open schools fully and in person.
sentences.zh: 大多数家长都在说，我们希望你们全面恢复线下开学。

sentences.en: And in fact, there was a survey done around this time, and 85% of parents told the district that's what they wanted for their kids.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当时曾进行过一项调查，85%的家长告诉学区，这正是他们为孩子所期望的。

sentences.en: So overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 太压倒性了。

sentences.en: Overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 压倒性的支持。

sentences.en: Cassandra Brown, Plumstead.
sentences.zh: 普拉姆斯特ッド的卡桑德拉·布朗。

sentences.en: Please return our schools back to normal.
sentences.zh: 请把我们的学校恢复正常。

sentences.en: Do not make our children suffer because some are afraid.
sentences.zh: 不要因为有些人害怕就让我们的孩子受苦。

sentences.en: Be strong, be brave, and don't be a sheep.
sentences.zh: 坚强点，勇敢点，不要做绵羊。

sentences.en: So around the same time, some of the parents who are most staunchly in favor of reopening are coming together in private Facebook groups, a lot in this one group called Reopen Box,
sentences.zh: 因此，大约在同一时期，一些最坚决支持复课的家长开始聚集在私密的 Facebook 群组中，其中很多人在一个名为“重新开放巴克斯”的群组里，

sentences.en: where they're having all these conversations among themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里彼此进行着各种交流。

sentences.en: And they start to grow increasingly frustrated with the district because despite the survey results, sort of this overwhelming support for reopening,
sentences.zh: 尽管有调查结果以及那种对复课的压倒性支持，他们还是开始对学区越来越感到沮丧，

sentences.en: the district just starts sending out these confusing mixed messages about their plans.
sentences.zh: 因为学区只是开始就其计划发出令人困惑的矛盾信息。

sentences.en: Okay, so in the plan, we address two different phases, green and yellow.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以在计划中，我们探讨两个不同的阶段，绿色和黄色。

sentences.en: Okay, it's all in person.
sentences.zh: 好的，全部都是线下。

sentences.en: Okay, now it's hybrid.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在是混合制。

sentences.en: And that is because we're looking to increase social distancing in that yellow phase, and so we cannot make a traditional model happen.
sentences.zh: 那是因为我们希望在黄色阶段增加社交距离，所以我们无法实现传统模式。

sentences.en: Okay, now it's all virtual in some grades.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在某些年级全部改为线上。

sentences.en: Which would only be for elementary.
sentences.zh: 那将仅限于小学。

sentences.en: And that gets these parents wondering, how exactly are these decisions being made?
sentences.zh: 这让这些家长们感到疑惑，这些决定究竟是如何做出的？

sentences.en: Hmm, well, what's their theory?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们的推测是什么？

sentences.en: What's their anxiety?
sentences.zh: 他们的焦虑是什么？

sentences.en: Well, for example, they're asking, you know, is the district bowing to pressure from the teachers' unions?
sentences.zh: 嗯，例如，他们在问，你知道，学区是在向教师工会的压力低头吗？

sentences.en: The superintendent, along with the teachers' union, continues to put unwarranted personal fear above professional responsibility.
sentences.zh: 总 superintendente（学区总监）与教师工会一起，继续将毫无根据的个人恐惧置于职业责任之上。

sentences.en: Like, is it the union that steps in and pushes these changes?
sentences.zh: 就像是工会介入并推动了这些改变吗？

sentences.en: If they are so scared, then they should resign their jobs and let someone step in who will put the children firSt.
sentences.zh: 如果他们这么害怕，那他们就应该辞职，让那些把孩子放在第一位的人来接替。

sentences.en: And so this group of parents, you know, they start to push harder, get more creative.
sentences.zh: 因此，这群家长开始施加更大的压力，变得更具创造力。

sentences.en: They're all talking amongst themselves across districts, and they say, you know, we should file public records requests.
sentences.zh: 他们在各个学区之间互相交流，并表示，你知道，我们应该提交公共记录申请。

sentences.en: Let's find out what emails are being sent, what people are talking on behind the scenes, figuring out who's acting in their interest and who's not.
sentences.zh: 让我们查清楚发送了哪些电子邮件，人们在幕后议论些什么，弄清楚谁在为他们的利益行事，谁没有。

sentences.en: And, you know, you discover that some emails the district doesn't want to turn over, and that makes you more suspicious, right?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你会发现学区有些邮件不想交出来，这让你更加怀疑，对吧？

sentences.en: So they kept asking for more and more.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直在索取更多、更多的资料。

sentences.en: And things emerge, things that may seem kind of granular if you're outside the district, but become very important in this whole fight.
sentences.zh: 事情浮出水面，如果你不在学区内部，这些事情可能看起来很琐碎，但在整场争斗中却变得非常重要。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: The school seemed to be going against the advice of the county health director, who would recommend relatively unrestrictive COVID plans, like three feet instead of six feet.
sentences.zh: 学校似乎违背了县卫生主任的建议，后者建议采取相对不那么严格的新冠防疫计划，比如三英尺而不是六英尺的社交距离。

sentences.en: I'm reopening.
sentences.zh: 重新开放。

sentences.en: And then the school would announce one that was more restrictive.
sentences.zh: 然后学校会宣布一个更严格的计划。

sentences.en: And after a summer in which the plans, you know, would change and the messaging seemed ambiguous, the parents had gotten pretty angry.
sentences.zh: 经过了一个夏天计划不断变化且信息似乎含糊不清的时期之后，家长们已经变得相当愤怒。

sentences.en: People moved to Central Bucks for their schools.
sentences.zh: 人们为了学校才搬到中央巴克斯。

sentences.en: This is what keeps our house values high.
sentences.zh: 这正是维持我们房价坚挺的原因。

sentences.en: I know if my kids are forced to be taught virtually, wear masks, sit in partitions, made to social distance, not to be able to play sports, go to recess, or eat in a lunchroom,
sentences.zh: 我知道，如果我的孩子被迫接受线上教学、戴口罩、坐在隔板后、保持社交距离、无法进行体育活动、去操场或是去餐厅吃饭，

sentences.en: I will look for alternative education.
sentences.zh: 我就会去寻找替代教育。

sentences.en: And eventually some of them filed a lawsuit against the district to try to force them to keep the schools open.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们中的一些人对学区提起诉讼，试图迫使他们保持学校开放。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And what ends up happening is that in September, the district announces that starting within the next few weeks, it will offer in-person learning at least part-time for everybody.
sentences.zh: 结果在9月份，学区宣布将在未来几周内开始为所有人提供至少是部分时间的线下学习。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And do we think that was in response to these parents, that this is a kind of victory?
sentences.zh: 我们认为这是对这些家长做出的回应，这算是一种胜利吗？

sentences.en: It's hard to say exactly what's correlation and causation with these decisions.
sentences.zh: 很难准确说这些决定中哪些是相关性，哪些是因果关系。

sentences.en: But, you know, the parents put a lot of pressure on and they got, I guess, a partial victory.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，家长们施加了很大的压力，我想他们取得了一定程度的局部胜利。

sentences.en: A lot of districts, you know, didn't go in person like this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多学区并没有像这样恢复线下上课。

sentences.en: And so they definitely felt emboldened and they felt like we can get things done if we put pressure on.
sentences.zh: 所以他们绝对感到备受鼓舞，觉得只要施加压力，我们就能把事情办成。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They have found some power that they didn't know they had.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了一种自己以前并不知道拥有的力量。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And Campbell, at this point, would you describe the situation, this dynamic between these parents and the school board as political?
sentences.zh: 坎贝尔，在这一点上，你会把这种局势，也就是这些家长与学校董事会之间的这种动态关系，描述为政治性的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, sort of.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，算是吧。

sentences.en: It's funny, right?
sentences.zh: 这挺有意思的，对吧？

sentences.en: But reopenings, you know, as an issue, technically are just apolitical, right?
sentences.zh: 但你知道，复课这个问题，从技术上讲其实是超脱政治的，对吧？

sentences.en: Parents of all political stripes were put in a really tough spot.
sentences.zh: 各种政治倾向的家长都陷入了非常艰难的境地。

sentences.en: People wanted schools to reopen.
sentences.zh: 人们希望学校重新开学。

sentences.en: And I even think a lot of the people who were foreclosures last year are now looking back saying, is this the right decision?
sentences.zh: 而且我甚至觉得，去年许多主张封锁的人现在回过头来也在想，这是正确的决定吗？

sentences.en: Should we have done it differently?
sentences.zh: 我们当时应该用不同的做法吗？

sentences.en: Obviously, lots of arguments there.
sentences.zh: 显然，那里有很多争论。

sentences.en: But the push for reopening always did have a bit of a partisan cast in terms of who ended up primarily mobilizing around it.
sentences.zh: 但推动复课的行动在谁最终主要围绕它进行动员方面，确实带有某种党派色彩。

sentences.en: You know, part of this is obviously because President Trump was such a driver of skepticism about how serious COVID was going to be, how aggressive COVID policies.
sentences.zh: 你知道，部分原因显然是因为特朗普总统极力对新冠病毒的严重程度以及新冠政策的激进程度表示怀疑。

sentences.en: You know, he was talking about, we got to reopen places.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他当时在谈论，我们必须让各地重新开放。

sentences.en: But, you know, among the parents who are pushing for reopenings, I also think there's this underlying idea that they're standing up against institutions, school boards, government,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，在推动复课的家长当中，我也认为存在一种潜在的想法，即他们是在对抗机构、学校董事会、政府、

sentences.en: bureaucracy, health departments, unions.
sentences.zh: 官僚机构、卫生部门、工会。

sentences.en: They're standing up against these institutions that they felt already had too much power over their lives, or certainly during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他们在对抗这些机构，因为他们觉得这些机构对他们的生活已经有了太多的控制权，或者至少在疫情期间是这样的。

sentences.en: So, again, reopening schools in and of itself, not a political issue, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，再说一次，学校复课本身并不是一个政治问题，对吧？

sentences.en: But what you start to see is this movement starts forming around reopening is this general sort of conservative worldview starts to surface.
sentences.zh: 但你开始看到的是，围绕复课开始形成的这场运动，展现出了一种普遍的保守派世界观。

sentences.en: So, there are now thousands of people who are part of Reopen Bucks and these other Facebook groups that have started forming about reopening.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在有成千上万的人加入了“重新开放巴克斯”以及其他为了复课而开始成立的Facebook群组。

sentences.en: And particularly starting around November with the presidential election, you see some of the members are now using these spaces to discuss other issues that matter to them.
sentences.zh: 特别是从11月份总统大选开始，你会发现一些成员现在正在利用这些空间来讨论对他们重要的其他问题。

sentences.en: On Reopen Bucks, they're post-supporting Trump, post-talking about this idea that the election was stolen.
sentences.zh: 在“重新开放巴克斯”上，他们发帖支持特朗普，发帖讨论选举被窃取的这种观点。

sentences.en: And, you know, somebody says, other states are spawning Trump rallies.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有人说，其他州正在掀起特朗普集会。

sentences.en: We should also.
sentences.zh: 我们也应该这样。

sentences.en: And it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有意思。

sentences.en: In response, you see this kind of sporadic effort by the group's moderators to keep everybody on topic.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，你可以看到该群组的管理员做出了零星的努力，试图让所有人专注于主题。

sentences.en: Sometimes they pop in to say, hey, everybody, this is a single-issue group.
sentences.zh: 有时他们会突然冒出来说，嘿，各位，这是一个单一议题的群组。

sentences.en: We're about reopening.
sentences.zh: 我们是来谈复课的。

sentences.en: And that's all we're about.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的全部内容。

sentences.en: But it sounds like for some of the members, it's becoming about more than that.
sentences.zh: 但听起来，对其中一些成员来说，事情已经不仅仅于此了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: So, now it's winter 2020, start of 2021.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在是2020年冬天，2021年年初。

sentences.en: We're in the thick of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于疫情的最深水区。

sentences.en: The parents who've been really pushing against COVID restrictions in the schools are still coming to the school board meetings, making comments.
sentences.zh: 那些一直极力反对学校新冠限制措施的家长们仍然来到学校董事会会议上发表意见。

sentences.en: And this, I think, is around the time when things start to shift.
sentences.zh: 而我认为，大约在这个时候，事情开始发生转变。

sentences.en: Good evening, everyone, and happy new year.
sentences.zh: 大家晚上好，新年快乐。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们邀请我。

sentences.en: On January 6th, an elementary school teacher shows up at a committee meeting to give a presentation.
sentences.zh: 1月6日，一名小学教师现身委员会会议进行展示说明。

sentences.en: Tonight, I'm just going to provide an overview of social-emotional learning.
sentences.zh: 今晚，我将简单概述社交情感学习。

sentences.en: And then, also, we're going to talk a little bit about the second-step update.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们也会稍微谈谈“第二步”计划的更新。

sentences.en: And second-step is the curriculum that we are implementing for the first time this school year at the elementary level.
sentences.zh: 而“第二步”是我们今年在小学阶段首次实施的课程。

sentences.en: This is an educational program that they've been piloting in her school that's designed to help students better understand one another and appreciate other perspectives.
sentences.zh: 这是他们在她所在的学校一直在试点的一个教育项目，旨在帮助学生更好地理解彼此并欣赏其他人的观点。

sentences.en: So, there was a picture for one lesson that I remember distinctly for fourth grade,
sentences.zh: 所以，我清晰地记得四年级有一节课的配图，

sentences.en: and it was a picture of two children looking at a roller coaster and understanding and just showing that visual for those students that some might find this very scary, right?
sentences.zh: 那是两个孩子看着过山车的画面，他们去理解并向这些学生直观地展示，有些人可能会觉得这非常可怕，对吧？

sentences.en: And some might find this exciting.
sentences.zh: 而有些人可能会觉得这很刺激。

sentences.en: And so, it really talks and gives them concrete examples of how to accept our differences.
sentences.zh: 所以它真正讨论并给出了具体例子，教我们如何接受彼此的差异。

sentences.en: And the reason she's there is because they're thinking about rolling this out to middle schoolers.
sentences.zh: 她之所以来到这里，是因为他们正在考虑将这个项目推广到初中生中。

sentences.en: And that's simply it.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: So, tonight, I'm happy to field any questions you have.
sentences.zh: 所以，今晚我很高兴回答你们提出的任何问题。

sentences.en: So, at the end of her presentation, she asked the board for feedback.
sentences.zh: 因此，在她的展示结束时，她向董事会征求反馈。

sentences.en: And one of the board members seems ready.
sentences.zh: 其中一位董事会成员似乎已经准备好了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, I actually do have a little bit of feedback from a parent who had reached out to me regarding a concern.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我其实确实有一些来自一位家长的反馈，这位家长就某个关切问题联系了我。

sentences.en: Back in November, they did receive a link that was sent, and it led to some content about anti-racism, Breonna Taylor, George Floyd,
sentences.zh: 早在11月份，他们确实收到过一个发送的链接，它通向一些关于反种族主义、布里安娜·泰勒、乔治·弗洛伊德的内容，

sentences.en: which, at the elementary level, the parent was quite concerned that this might be some heavy content for elementary school children,
sentences.zh: 对于小学阶段，这位家长相当担心这可能会成为小学生比较沉重的内容，

sentences.en: and asked what it is that we are doing with this.
sentences.zh: 并询问我们对此正在做些什么。

sentences.en: So, as I've been able to piece it together, what happened is a newsletter went out from the school about this program.
sentences.zh: 因此，根据我的拼凑了解，发生的事情是学校发布了一份关于这个项目的简报。

sentences.en: And it contained a link to the program's website.
sentences.zh: 其中包含了一个指向该项目网站的链接。

sentences.en: So, let me pull that up.
sentences.zh: 那么让我把它调出来。

sentences.en: Once you get to the website, there's a drop-down menu with resources.
sentences.zh: 一旦你进入该网站，就会有一个包含资源的下拉菜单。

sentences.en: And there are about seven or eight resources there.
sentences.zh: 那里大约有七、八个资源。

sentences.en: And one of them is anti-racism and anti-bias resources.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是反种族主义和反偏见资源。

sentences.en: So, you click on that, and it takes you to another page with a lot of different links to different organizations, different prograMs.
sentences.zh: 所以你点击它，它会把你带到另一个页面，上面有很多指向不同组织、不同项目的各种链接。

sentences.en: And at the bottom of that page, there is a link that says, supporting racial equity with culturally responsive pedagogy.
sentences.zh: 在该页面的底部，有一个链接写着“以文化响应式教学法支持种族平等”。

sentences.en: So, if you click on that, it takes you to another website.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你点击它，它会把你带到另一个网站。

sentences.en: And you scroll down that, and there's a passage, and the first sentence is, the murders of George Floyd, Ahmaud Arbery, and Breonna Taylor, among many others,
sentences.zh: 你在那上面往下滚动，有一段话，第一句是，乔治·弗洛伊德、阿毛德·阿贝里和布里安娜·泰勒等许多人的遇害，

sentences.en: have dramatically underscored the racial injustices within our country's systeMs.
sentences.zh: 极大地凸显了我国体制内的种族不公正现象。

sentences.en: And it seems a parent with concerns about that had reached out to a board member ahead of the meeting
sentences.zh: 似乎有一位对此感到担忧的家长在会议召开前联系了一位董事会成员，

sentences.en: and found a receptive audience.
sentences.zh: 并且找到了愿意倾听的听众。

sentences.en: I do have to say that some of the things that I saw on the website recently, dealing with systemic racism, implicit bias, and social justice, caused some concern for me.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我最近在网站上看到的一些关于系统性种族主义、内隐偏见和社会正义的内容，确实引起了我的担忧。

sentences.en: But, I'm sorry, I'm trying to understand where this was in.
sentences.zh: 但是，抱歉，我在努力理解这是在哪里。

sentences.en: Because I know that's not in our lab.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道那不在我们的实验室里。

sentences.en: At this point, it doesn't seem like a lot of people are organizing around this, or even know about it.
sentences.zh: 此时，似乎并没有很多人围绕这一点进行组织，甚至都不知道这件事。

sentences.en: It's more like a couple of board members are basically like, yeah, you know, now that you mention it, I have concerns about that, too.
sentences.zh: 更像是几个董事会成员基本上在说，对啊，你知道，既然你提到了，我对此也有担忧。

sentences.en: I, too, have a problem with jumping into all the new resources that have been put on this website since we first approved the program.
sentences.zh: 对于自从我们首次批准该项目以来被放到这个网站上的所有新资源，我也觉得突然介入有问题。

sentences.en: So, to your understanding, just for the lessons itself, at no point are students going to that website.
sentences.zh: 所以据你理解，仅就课程本身而言，学生在任何时候都不会去那个网站。

sentences.en: Those resources on that website are really for adults.
sentences.zh: 该网站上的那些资源其实是给成年人准备的。

sentences.en: But by the next meeting...
sentences.zh: 但在下次会议之前……

sentences.en: The program's resources have changed, some of which include anti-police rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 该项目的资源已经发生了变化，其中一些包含了反警察的言论。

sentences.en: Parents are pouring in to talk about this.
sentences.zh: 家长们纷纷涌入来谈论这件事。

sentences.en: I sincerely implore you to revisit the content of this program, as I believe we prefer that our children not be programmed
sentences.zh: 我诚挚地恳请你们重新审视该项目的内容，因为我相信我们更希望我们的孩子们不被灌输

sentences.en: into having a vision of authority of police that is cynical and distrustful.
sentences.zh: 一种愤世嫉俗且充满不信任的警察权威观。

sentences.en: And now we have these two camps of parents at the meetings.
sentences.zh: 现在我们会议上有这两大阵营的家长。

sentences.en: We are not born with these biases.
sentences.zh: 我们生来并非带有这些偏见。

sentences.en: This means that anti-racism, diversity, inclusion, and equity can be taught as well.
sentences.zh: 这意味着反种族主义、多样性、包容性和平等同样是可以被教导的。

sentences.en: We are in a crisis.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于危机之中。

sentences.en: And while I understand that these issues need to be addressed carefully, especially with our youngest students, I wholeheartedly believe that they need to be addressed.
sentences.zh: 虽然我理解这些问题需要谨慎处理，尤其是对我们年龄最小的学生，但我全心全意地相信这些问题必须得到解决。

sentences.en: We're here to ask that Central Bucks be a leader to parents and kids alike in a world that desperately needs diversity, anti-racist, and bravery.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里是要求中央巴克斯在这样一个极其需要多样性、反种族主义和勇敢精神的世界里，成为家长和孩子们的榜样。

sentences.en: And not pander to a handful of parents that will not address their own racism and their own bias.
sentences.zh: 而不是迎合一小撮不愿正视自身种族主义和偏见的家长。

sentences.en: It's time for Central Bucks and its parents and its community to address the ugliness and lead with compassion and bravery.
sentences.zh: 现在是中央巴克斯及其家长和社区正视丑陋现实并以同情和勇敢引领的时候了。

sentences.en: So what do we think happened in the time between these two meetings?
sentences.zh: 那么我们认为这两次会议之间发生了什么？

sentences.en: What happened is that another group of already organized parents is drawn into the school board meetings.
sentences.zh: 发生的事情是，另一个已经组织起来的家长群体被吸引到了学校董事会会议上。

sentences.en: Obviously, Reopen Bucks and these other reopening groups are not the only Facebook groups where people in the community are gathering to talk.
sentences.zh: 很明显，“重新开放巴克斯”和其他复课组织并不是社区人们聚在一起交流的仅有的Facebook群组。

sentences.en: There are all these progressive groups in Bucks, some of which go back for years.
sentences.zh: 巴克斯有所有这些进步派组织，其中一些已经存在了好多年。

sentences.en: Many of them organized in the wake of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人是在乔治·弗洛伊德事件之后组织起来的。

sentences.en: They were pushing the district on its diversity and equity plans, trying to draw attention to what they saw as racist curriculum within the schools, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在就多元化和公平计划向学区施压，试图将人们的注意力吸引到他们认为学校里存在的种族主义课程等方面。

sentences.en: Well, they hear about what happened at this second step meeting.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们听说了这次“第二步”会议上发生的事情。

sentences.en: And they're talking amongst themselves, and they agree to show up at that next board meeting to defend the program.
sentences.zh: 他们在私下交流，并同意出席下一次董事会会议来捍卫这个项目。

sentences.en: And they have this big turnout, right?
sentences.zh: 他们有这么大的出席规模，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, now some of the more conservative parents, you know, some of whom have already been part of the reopening movement, some not, they notice that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在一些比较保守的家长，你知道，其中一些已经是复课运动的一部分，另一些则不是，他们注意到了这一点。

sentences.en: And they react.
sentences.zh: 他们做出了反应。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Dennis Hart.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是丹尼斯·哈特。

sentences.en: I'm from Buckingham.
sentences.zh: 我来自白金汉。

sentences.en: My wife and I have a daughter in the school district.
sentences.zh: 我和我妻子在学区里有一个女儿。

sentences.en: We are concerned as taxpayers that the district would continue to focus on threading the LGBTQ plus dogma into the curriculum at all our schools.
sentences.zh: 作为纳税人，我们担心学区会继续把精力放在将LGBTQ+教条渗透到我们所有学校的课程中。

sentences.en: And some of them start to file a new set of public records requests to see what they can uncover about how the schools have been communicating on those topics.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人开始提交新一批的公共记录请求，以查明他们能发现关于学校如何在这些话题上进行沟通的什么信息。

sentences.en: It seems more like an indoctrination meant to expand the population of LGBTQ plus than actual learning.
sentences.zh: 这看起来更像是旨在扩大LGBTQ+人口的灌输，而不是真正的学习。

sentences.en: And on the other side, you've had even more people come into the meetings to defend these topics and programs, some of which have actually been around for a long time.
sentences.zh: 而在另一边，有更多的人来到会议现场捍卫这些主题和项目，其中一些项目其实已经存在很长时间了。

sentences.en: I'm a cisgender white male and stepfather to two kids in the Central Block School District, and friend, ally, and advocate for trans,
sentences.zh: 我是个顺性别白人男性，也是中央巴克斯学区两个孩子的继父，是跨性别、

sentences.en: non-binary, and non-conforming gender students.
sentences.zh: 非二元性别和不符合性别规范的学生的友人、盟友和倡导者。

sentences.en: So you've got these two camps, neither of which are new,
sentences.zh: 所以你有这两个阵营，它们都不是新出现的，

sentences.en: suddenly fighting in this new space.
sentences.zh: 突然在这个新的空间里交战。

sentences.en: Some of their fights are the same fights they've been fighting for years, and some of them are old fights just in new forMs.
sentences.zh: 他们的一些斗争是他们多年来一直在进行的斗争，其中一些则是换了新形式的老斗争。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: What does critical race theory do?
sentences.zh: 批判性种族理论起什么作用？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: It subscribes to Marxist theory, which begins in a class struggle.
sentences.zh: 它信奉马克思主义理论，该理论始于阶级斗争。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: One week later, the board holds its regularly scheduled meeting.

sentences.en: And as it turns out, the state's mandate leaves a fair bit of leeway for students to get mask exemptions based on like medical or mental health conditions.

sentences.en: Because the state's mandate doesn't require a doctor's signature.

sentences.en: And think about that.

sentences.en: So the questionnaire that anyone who wants a waiver from the mask requirement has to fill out for their child says,

sentences.en: I hereby seek an exception because wearing a face covering would cause or exacerbate A, A, medical condition, B, mental health condition, C, disability, et cetera, et cetera.

sentences.en: So one of the central arguments of parents who oppose masks is that they are psychologically damaging to kids.
sentences.zh: 因此，反对口罩的家长们的核心论点之一是，口罩对孩子会造成心理伤害。

sentences.en: So without requiring a doctor's note, just about any parent could make this case based on the fact that they are opposed to masks.
sentences.zh: 因此，无需医生的证明，几乎任何家长都可以根据他们反对口罩这一事实来提出这个申请。

sentences.en: So what I learned is that some of the members who are on the board who were against a mask mandate and would have seen the state's order and been against that,
sentences.zh: 所以我了解到的是，董事会中一些反对口罩令、本会对州的命令持反对态度的成员

sentences.en: read it and start to say to themselves, you know what, this is a version of a mandate we can actually get behind.

sentences.en: This is ridiculous.

sentences.en: All of it.

sentences.en: This turns out to be one of the wildest, most raucous meetings of the whole year.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这是全年最疯狂、最吵闹的会议之一。

sentences.en: We're now at the part of the story that you've been seeing all over the news.
sentences.zh: 我们现在来到了你在新闻上经常看到的那个故事部分。

sentences.en: And just as it's about to wind up, John Gamble makes an announcement.

sentences.en: I would like to be able to put my two cents in.

sentences.en: Sure.

sentences.en: Following his vote against the mask mandate the previous week.

sentences.en: No one is listening with any intent to understand the other point of view.

sentences.en: Hi, concerned parent here.

sentences.en: I'm just wondering how many child deaths is enough before you change your policy?

sentences.en: I mean, you and your board are putting our children at risk.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你和你的董事会正在把我们的孩子置于危险之中。

sentences.en: Do you believe we're just going to sit here and allow that to happen?
sentences.zh: 你们难道以为我们会坐视不管，任由这种事发生吗？

sentences.en: You're literally causing children's deaths.

sentences.en: Go fuck yourself, you piece of shit fucker.
sentences.zh: 滚你妈的，你这个烂透了的混蛋。

sentences.en: To be clear, from all the people I've talked to in Bucks County, this is not the first death threat during this time.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，根据我和巴克斯县所有人的交谈，这并不是这段时间以来的第一起死亡威胁。

sentences.en: But it's a breaking point for Gamble.
sentences.zh: 但对甘布尔来说，这是个临界点。

sentences.en: It's been a hellacious week since last Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 自从上周三以来，这真是地狱般的一周。

sentences.en: He blames what's happening on the position he feels he's been put in as the swing vote on the mask issue.
sentences.zh: 他将发生的一切归咎于他作为口罩问题关键中间选票所被迫处于的立场。

sentences.en: A position he's about to be put in once again as he takes this vote.

sentences.en: But if I'm doing my straw poll already, you guys are putting me as the fifth vote again, putting me in the meat grinder again.
sentences.zh: 但如果我已经做好了民意测验，你们又要把我当成第五票，再次把我塞进绞肉机里。

sentences.en: If I vote for masks, I send the message that a board member's vote can be swayed by public bullying.

sentences.en: If I vote for a mask optional, I will be facing a very real confirmed death threat from a member of the community.

sentences.en: No matter how I vote, I will leave here tonight as public enemy number one for half the people in this room again.
sentences.zh: 无论我怎么投票，今晚离开这里时，我再次成为这个房间里半数人眼中的头号公敌。

sentences.en: And I'm here because I care about the district and our children.
sentences.zh: 我来这里是因为我关心学区和我们的孩子。

sentences.en: But when I need a police escort to enter a building for a meeting, even I have a breaking point.
sentences.zh: 但当我进开会大楼需要警察护送时，连我也有忍耐的极限。

sentences.en: You guys are digging for information on my wife.

sentences.en: How dare you?
sentences.zh: 你们怎么敢？

sentences.en: She had to teach yesterday with somebody guarding her classroom because you threatened my family.
sentences.zh: 她昨天去上课时还得有人在教室门口保卫，因为你们威胁了我的家人。

sentences.en: You disgust me.

sentences.en: You don't deserve the service that has been put in.
sentences.zh: 你们不配享受这里付出的服务。

sentences.en: So tonight, I'm done with the hostility.
sentences.zh: 所以今晚，我受够了这种敌意。

sentences.en: I'm done with your bullying, the shameful behavior, the politics and the threats.
sentences.zh: 我受够了你们的霸凌、这种无耻的行为、政治把戏和威胁。

sentences.en: So effective tonight, I resign.

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: And in one of his last acts as a member of the board, he cast a deciding vote in favor of adopting the state's mask mandate.
sentences.zh: 作为他作为董事会成员的最后行动之一，他投下了决定性的一票，支持采纳州的口罩强制令。

sentences.en: COVID has broken you people and it's disgusting.
sentences.zh: 新冠疫情把你们这些人击垮了，这真恶心。

sentences.en: I watch how you treat each other in here.

sentences.en: It's disgusting.

sentences.en: Never before, I have to think, has there been so much attention on schools and what's going on in school districts like Central Bucks.

sentences.en: But the focus has become so political, even if it started with the practical question of whether the schools would reopen.

sentences.en: And as it's become more and more political, it seems like the focus of all this energy and attention has drifted further and further from what's going on in the schools themselves.
